hardware.question: Do I need hardware to try Agrolify?
hardware.answer: You can explore the demo with sample data and no hardware. Monitoring your own greenhouse requires a device running Agrolify firmware, connected sensors, and the appropriate pumps, fans, or window motors for the controls you want to use.

automation.question: What can I automate?
automation.answer: You can schedule recurring watering and let the fan respond to temperature thresholds. You can also switch the fan to manual mode and open or close each window from the dashboard.

connection.question: Does my greenhouse need an internet connection?
connection.answer: Yes. The device needs a connection to Agrolify for live readings, remote commands, and server-managed automation. The dashboard shows connection status and whether a control command is awaiting confirmation. Historical data remains available when the device is offline.

identity.title: Air
identity.description: Track canopy temperature, humidity stability, and atmospheric balance in one structured workspace designed for day-to-day greenhouse operations.

temperature.subtitle: Trendline for canopy temperature, stabilization, and thermal drift.

humidity.subtitle: Relative humidity distribution across the selected operating window.

temperature.infoTooltip: This shows the current air temperature measured around the canopy. It helps you track how warm or cool the greenhouse air is compared with the recent average.

humidity.infoTooltip: This shows the current relative humidity in the air. It helps you understand how much moisture is present and whether the greenhouse is drying down or staying humid.

vpd.label: Air moisture balance
vpd.helper: A healthy balance usually stays between 0.8 and 1.3 kPa.
vpd.infoTooltip: Calculated from air temperature and humidity. First we estimate the maximum vapor pressure the air can hold at the current temperature, then subtract the actual vapor pressure based on the current relative humidity.

condensationRisk.label: Moisture buildup risk
condensationRisk.infoTooltip: Estimated from current relative humidity. Higher humidity increases the chance that moisture can collect on plants, structures, or nearby surfaces, especially during cooler transitions.
condensationRisk.elevatedHelper: Humidity is elevated and moisture could collect on plants or surfaces.
condensationRisk.safeHelper: Air moisture is currently in a safer range.

identity.title: Soil intelligence
identity.description: A dedicated view for substrate temperature, moisture behavior, and root-zone operating quality with enough structure to grow into deeper agronomy analytics.

moisture.subtitle: Root-zone saturation pattern and drying curve across the selected range.

temperature.subtitle: Substrate temperature distribution supporting root activity and uptake.

moisture.infoTooltip: This shows the current soil moisture reading from the root zone. It helps you see whether the substrate is drying out, balanced, or holding too much water.

temperature.infoTooltip: This shows the current soil temperature around the roots. It helps indicate whether the substrate is within a healthy range for root activity and nutrient uptake.

rootScore.label: Root-zone score
rootScore.infoTooltip: This score combines soil moisture and soil temperature to show how suitable the root zone is for plant activity. Higher values mean conditions are closer to the target balance.

efficiency.label: Irrigation efficiency
efficiency.helper: Shows how closely watering hits target recovery.
efficiency.infoTooltip: This estimates how well irrigation is restoring soil moisture toward the target range. Higher values mean watering behavior is more aligned with the expected soil response.

identity.title: Water intelligence
identity.description: A production-ready water operations view for reservoir health, demand visibility, and irrigation schedule awareness with space to grow into a richer control center.

tankLevel.label: Water level
tankLevel.infoTooltip: This shows the current tank fill level as a percentage of the total tank capacity set for the device.

autonomy.label: Refill autonomy
autonomy.infoTooltip: This estimates how many days the current water reserve can last based on the calculated daily water draw.

draw.label: Daily draw
draw.infoTooltip: This estimates how much water the system is using per day based on the reservoir level movement over the selected time range.

coverage.label: Schedule coverage
coverage.infoTooltip: This shows how much of the watering plan is covered by the currently configured irrigation schedule. Higher values mean the device has better schedule support.

chart.title: Water level
chart.subtitle: Monitor reserve movement and identify refill windows before the tank reaches risk thresholds.
